answer: Because the crystal nonce is published only after close, the beacon audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 255 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate orchard derivation per key. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
